page.overview:
What is Rising Volt Tacklers?

and Founding member )|Roy (Current leader)}}

The Rising Volt Tacklers are a team of adventurers led by Professor Friede and later Roy, appearing as the protagonists in .

Under the leadership of Professor Friede, the Rising Volt Tacklers travel the world aboard the Brave Olivine to uncover secrets and discover new Pokémon. They are currently investigating a mysterious pendant, similar to one held by their rivals, the Explorers. Recently, they have been joined by Liko, the pendant’s current owner, and Roy.

Following the incident at Laqua, where they lost sight of Friede, the group disbanded after being falsely accused by Spinel, who framed them for the Laqua incident. However, a year later, Roy reassembled the team with Liko and Dot to clear their name and confront the Explorers. Friede would later hand his mantle to Roy after a battle between them. And they finally succeeded in their efforts; saving the world and proving their innocence.
